rationale: The synchronous AXI-stream FIFO has a single declared clock and complete delays for its write-side and read-side handshake and payload ports.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the FIFO to a four-entry, 16-bit synchronous AXI-stream queue.

mutation.description: The memory and pointer widths are reduced while preserving one synchronous clock and the ready/valid timing contract.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: Single clock with delays on every synchronous port.
